description:
Get a single SEO Reporting report by id: its metadata (name, is_template, is_automate, created_at, owner, and period/recipient_user_ids when scheduled) plus its widget structure (each widget's type, title, position, config and filters). Returns the report's composition, not rendered analytics numbers — read the underlying metrics with the GSC/GA4 tools. Use generate_report to produce a shareable snapshot URL. Get the reportId from list_reports. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// fetch one report's metadata and widgets.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","reportId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"}
```
name: get_report
title: Report detail
